name: Matix Corporation
old_description: Matix Corporation of America is a world class metal machining manufacturer of O.E.M. automotive parts ranging from aluminum oil pan housings, 4-wheel driver adaptor housings, oil pump covers, and many more.  We are the largest value-added machining supplier to Asian Automotive in North America.
about:
Matix Corporation of America was founded in 2001 in Pioneer, Tennessee, nestled in the mountains of Campbell County. The company began as a cylinder head machining operation in a 40,000-square-foot facility, breaking ground that year as its phase 1 operation. Over the next two decades, Matix expanded its footprint and capabilities to become a dedicated producer of machined automotive components.

Today, the company operates a 106,000-square-foot plant housing 13 product lines that produce over two million machined components annually. Using automated CNC machining centers and modern robotics, Matix manufactures engine, drivetrain, and chassis parts such as aluminum oil pan housings, four-wheel-drive adaptor housings, oil pump covers, crankcase stiffeners, and fluid coupling cases. The facility employs over 110 team members.

Matix serves the automotive OEM market as a Tier 2 supplier, notably to Toyota, and describes itself as the largest value-added machining supplier to Asian automotive manufacturers in North America. Its customer base includes top global automakers requiring high-volume, precision-machined metal parts.

The company emphasizes precision quality processes and automation to meet the demands of top global automakers, leveraging its ISO 9001-certified quality system to ensure consistent part quality across high-volume production runs.
